summary: Trident Digital Tech Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on September 24, 2026, disclosing receipt of a September 22, 2026 Nasdaq notification that the company regained compliance with Listing Rule 5550(b)(2) after maintaining minimum market value of listed securities of US$35 million for ten consecutive business days from September 8 to September 21, 2026. The deficiency notice was originally received March 26, 2026, giving a 180-day cure period ending September 22, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, stake, price, or transaction mechanics are stated; the filing is a routine listing-compliance update.
